usedFor: Podio holds items and workspaces, and Google Docs receives their details through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Item Created” in Podio, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A new item writes its details into a chosen tab, so the document reflects the work.

watchOut: “Item Updated” in Podio is polling and does not run for comments, so changes appear after a scheduled check.
